name: Buscar y alternar tema oscuro funcionan sin errores
description: El buscar acepta texto y el botón de tema alterna entre modo claro y oscuro, persistiendo la preferencia sin romper la página.

planSteps.description: Click on the search input and type 'antivirus'
The search input contains the typed text 'antivirus' and the page shows no error
Click the theme toggle button (accessed by aria-label 'Alternar tema oscuro/claro')
The page switches its color theme (light/dark) and the change is visibly applied to the page background
Click the theme toggle button again
The theme switches back and the page still renders correctly with no errors
